'''Line Lieutenant''' was a title used by the [[Empire of the Hand]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="CrisisD">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> the Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Dramos Sanjin]], who served aboard the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]'', held the title.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="CrisisD" /> he participated in a [[Attack on the Red City|battle]] between Imperial forces and the [[Storm-hair]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s forces on the<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]. Sanjin [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] three stormtrooper [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] during the battle, which ended with Esva's defeat.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
A Line Lieutenant appeared in the novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published in [[2011]] as part of the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of the [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
